run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

===

improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let users dynamically `source` the zsh completion script (`source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`) instead of requiring it to be written to a file on `fpath`, and document both installation methods in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Met — the change implements and, by focused test, verifies both steps of the PR's test plan and the exact repro from issue BurntSushi/ripgrep#2956.
summary.coverage: Both changed files (FAQ.md; crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh) read in full against the merge-base diff. `crates/core/flags/complete/zsh.rs` confirmed the completion script is emitted verbatim by `rg --generate complete-zsh`, so the tracked file is the exact reviewed artifact. Offline zsh execution reproduced the reported bug at the merge-base, confirmed the fix at head, and confirmed no regression to the classic fpath/autoload install path or to `ci/test-complete`'s invocation style; `cargo build`/`cargo test` and `ci/test-complete` itself were unavailable offline (no vendored registry, no built `rg`).
check_details: Reviewer ran a scratch zsh script sourcing the merge-base's generated completion script (with `compinit` loaded) at merge-base 79cbe89d: reproduces the exact reported error, `_arguments:comparguments:325: can only be called from completion function`.

Reviewer ran the same script against the head's generated completion script at head 855bfa6c: sources cleanly with no error, and `compdef` registers `$_comps[rg]=_rg`, so future `<TAB>` completion for `rg` dispatches to `_rg`.

Reviewer ran the head's completion script sourced with no `compinit` ever loaded at head 855bfa6c: fails the same way as the merge-base (command not found: `_arguments`), showing this pre-existing limitation is unchanged by the fix, not newly introduced.

Reviewer ran `_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source rg.zsh` (the exact invocation `ci/test-complete`'s `get_comp_args` uses, no `compinit`) against the head's script at head 855bfa6c: exits 0 and lists the `_arguments` specs, so the CI arg-diff check's mechanism keeps working under the new dispatch branch.

Reviewer ran `autoload -Uz _rg` then invoked `_rg` directly from `$fpath` (simulating the classic fpath-install autoload path) with `compinit` loaded, at head 855bfa6c: reaches the `_arguments` spec-listing code exactly as before, confirming the primary, pre-existing completion-install method is unaffected.

observations.fact: The classic fpath-install completion path (`autoload`-ing `_rg` from a directory on `$fpath`) is preserved: the new `[[ $funcstack[1] == _rg ]]` branch still calls `_rg "$@"` directly in that case, matching pre-change behavior.
observations.evidence: crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:438-443 (diff, RIGHT); confirmed by focused test.

observations.fact: The change also fixes an unrelated, pre-existing typo in FAQ.md's completions intro ("completes" → "completions"), bundled into the same commit.

requirements.evidence: crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:438-443 (diff): focused test shows sourcing the head script with `compinit` loaded produces no error, versus the reported error reproduced at merge-base 79cbe89d with the pre-fix script.

requirements.evidence: After sourcing the head script with `compinit` loaded, `$_comps[rg]` is set to `_rg` (focused test), which is what zsh's completion dispatcher consults to route `<TAB>` completion for the `rg` command.
Issue #2956's exact repro command and error text were reproduced at merge-base 79cbe89d and shown fixed at head 855bfa6c by focused test.

Review thread comments 6-8 record that `ci/test-complete` requires the `compdef`-existence check now in the code; focused test reproducing `ci/test-complete`'s exact `_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source` invocation against the head script exits 0 with the expected arg-spec listing.
